plainText:
Togepi (Japanese: トゲピー Togepy) is a Pokémon in Magical Pokémon Journey. Togepi first appears in Eggcellent Togepi. It considers and as its parents and tends to appear at random.

== History ==
 
Pikachu and Clefairy meet Togepi when it was an Egg found lying around on a river. They mistaken it for a watermelon at first as it wasn't introduced to their time yet.
